text: もぐって…　うみ　ポケモン　とろうと　がんばってた　けど　…やっぱ　だめ！

structure.jp: うみ　ポケモン　とろうと
がんばってた　けど
structure.en: I was doing my best, but

patterns.name: 〜ようと
patterns.span: とろうと　がんばってた
patterns.explanation: The 'let's do' form of a verb with と shows what someone is aiming to do. とろうと　がんばってた = 'I was trying hard to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: がんばってた is the shortened spoken form of がんばっていた. It shows something that was going on for a while. がんばってた = 'I was trying hard'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.span: がんばってた　けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with 'but'. がんばってた　けど = 'I was trying hard, but'.
